release_notes: Added: a local landing is served at /lander/<slug>/ (matching Keitaro), with a Code/Preview toggle in the editor. The Domains page now shows a banner explaining why SSL issuance is unavailable on the current server (no shell, no Certbot, no nginx config, non-writable ACME dir) instead of leaving parked domains silently 'waiting'. Fixed: PHP called shell_exec directly in 46 places — on hosts where the function is removed rather than disabled, PHP 8 raises an Error that @ does not suppress, so saving a domain or syncing the nginx config died as a bare 500; everything now goes through core/shell.php. git pull aborted on every install.sh install because the installer chmod +x'd cli/*.php and git tracks the executable bit — the bit is gone and core.fileMode is turned off. A fullchain.pem holding only the leaf (missing the intermediate) — the case where the site opens in Firefox but fails in Chrome with 'unable to get local issuer certificate' — is now detected and marked failed with an 'incomplete_chain' reason instead of 'installed'. Server-side error messages are no longer hard-coded in Russian: the backend returns machine codes plus a detail object of measured facts, and the frontend phrases them per locale across all seven languages.
